title: Targeting UBE2T by beta-elemene inhibits prostate cancer stem cells and bone metastasis by blocking the TRIM28/pGSK3beta/beta-catenin signaling.
authors: Huang, Renlun; Chen, Chiwei; Wang, Zhichao; Zhang, Qiuhong; Cao, Jiadong; Wang, Wei; Xiang, Songtao
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究beta-elemene靶向UBE2T抑制前列腺癌干细胞及骨转移，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是蛋白-小分子及泛素化信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Bone metastasis remains a major clinical challenge in advanced prostate cancer (PCa). Although beta-elemene has been shown to suppress cancer stem cells and tumor progression, its mechanism in PCa is not fully understood. PURPOSE: This study investigated the specific mechanism by which beta-elemene impeded prostate cancer stem cells (PCSCs) and PCa metastasis. METHODS: First, we constructed a progression-free survival (PFS) prediction model and performed survival analysis to screen candidate genes through bioinformatic analysis. Second, the direct binding of beta-elemene to UBE2T was validated by molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and surface plasmon resonance (SPR). And In vivo xenograft tumorigenicity assays were conducted to assess the activation of PCSCs by UBE2T. Mechanistically, co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), in vivo ubiquitination assays, and immunoprecipitation-mass spectrometry (IP-MS) were employed to investigate the role of UBE2T in cooperating with E3 ubiquitin ligases to promote the degradation of the substrate protein pGSK3beta. RESULTS: Functionally, beta-elemene inhibited PCa cell proliferation, migration, invasion, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), and the self-renewal of PCSCs. In vivo, UBE2T promoted the activation and tumorigenicity of PCSCs, while beta-elemene attenuated UBE2T-driven stemness, tumor growth, and bone metastasis. Mechanistically, UBE2T cooperated with TRIM28 to facilitate K48-linked ubiquitination and degradation of pGSK3beta, thereby disrupting the beta-catenin degradation complex, and promoting its nuclear translocation. These effects were partially reversed by beta-elemene. Clinical tissue microarray analysis further confirmed UBE2T as an oncogene associated with poor prognosis in advanced PCa. CONCLUSION: Collectively, our findings demonstrate that beta-elemene suppresses the self-renewal of PCSCs and bone metastasis by targeting the UBE2T/TRIM28/pGSK3beta/beta-catenin signaling axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨转移仍然是晚期前列腺癌（PCa）临床治疗中的重大挑战。尽管β-榄香烯已被证明能抑制癌症干细胞和肿瘤进展，但其在PCa中的作用机制尚未完全阐明。目的：本研究探讨了β-榄香烯抑制前列腺癌干细胞（PCSCs）及PCa转移的具体机制。方法：首先，我们构建了无进展生存期（PFS）预测模型，并通过生物信息学分析进行生存分析以筛选候选基因。其次，通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和表面等离子体共振（SPR）验证了β-榄香烯与UBE2T的直接结合。此外，进行了体内异种移植肿瘤形成实验，以评估UBE2T对PCSCs的激活作用。在机制层面，采用免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）、体内泛素化实验和免疫沉淀-质谱（IP-MS）来研究UBE2T与E3泛素连接酶协同促进底物蛋白pGSK3beta降解的作用。结果：在功能上，β-榄香烯抑制了PCa细胞增殖、迁移、侵袭、上皮-间质转化（EMT）及PCSCs的自我更新。在体内，UBE2T促进了PCSCs的激活和致瘤性，而β-榄香烯减弱了UBE2T驱动的干性、肿瘤生长和骨转移。在机制上，UBE2T与TRIM28协同促进pGSK3beta的K48连接泛素化和降解，从而破坏β-catenin降解复合物，并促进其核转位。这些效应部分被β-榄香烯逆转。临床组织微阵列分析进一步证实UBE2T是与晚期PCa不良预后相关的致癌基因。结论：总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，β-榄香烯通过靶向UBE2T/TRIM28/pGSK3beta/β-catenin信号轴抑制PCSCs的自我更新和骨转移。
